subject: code not working with eventReactive, but with observeEvent

messages.author: 9349b31ec7c243b2
messages.subject: code not working with eventReactive, but with observeEvent
parts:
I have an odd problem. My code is not working with a structure like
sim.results <- eventReactive(input$goButton,{
    SimulateFunction(input,sample.par,session)
})

But it is working with
observeEvent(input$goButton,{
    sim.results <<- SimulateFunction(input,sample.par,session)
})

Sorry that I can't put a minimal example together, the upper code works in all simple cases. Did anyone have a problem like this?
Thanks,
D.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: code not working with eventReactive, but with observeEvent
parts: In the first example, are you actually calling sim.results() from any observer or output? eventReactive and reactive are both lazy; they don't run unless/until their values are requested.
On Thu, Dec 17, 2015 at 10:34 PM Dawg <dag.l...@katrisk.com> wrote:

Thanks,
D.
